alt: Building an N by M grid of vowels and consonants by a checkerboard pattern, row by row, until every row and every column has the same vowel count; or detecting immediately that no such grid can exist when that count cannot split evenly.

steps.caption: Row 0: (row + col) % 2 decides vowel or consonant, 2 vowels and 2 consonants.
Row 1: (row + col) % 2 decides vowel or consonant, 2 vowels and 2 consonants.
Row 2: (row + col) % 2 decides vowel or consonant, 2 vowels and 2 consonants.
Row 3: (row + col) % 2 decides vowel or consonant, 2 vowels and 2 consonants.
Try splitting every row evenly: 2 vowels and 2 consonants each, 6 vowels across all 3 rows.
Spread evenly over 4 columns, each needs 6 / 4 = 1.5 vowels, not a whole number. Impossible.
